title: Rate Card: Day Rates, Weekly Rates and Late Return Charges
content:
## The published rates

The rates below are the published rates for an intermediate vehicle on each of the six
Car Rental Rate Classes, together with the charges that run when a vehicle is kept past its booked return. Every figure is
in US dollars except the grace period, which is in minutes.

| Rate class | Daily rate | Weekly rate | Saturday and Sunday rate | Rate for a day kept beyond the booked return | Charge for each hour past the grace period | Grace period, in minutes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 38.5 | 229 | 32 | 58 | 14 | 29 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 46.75 | 279 | 39 | 62 | 14 | 29 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 54 | 325 | 49 | 68 | 12 | 59 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 68.25 | 399 | 62 | 75 | 10 | 59 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 89.5 | 529 | 82 | 95 | 9 | 89 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 59 | 349 | 55 | 65 | 10 | 59 |

## Notes to the rate card

1. The daily rate, the weekly rate and the weekend rate are three published rates for the same vehicle
   class, not three charges. Which of them a rental is priced at is settled by the rental's own length and
   days, and the rate card carries all three so that any of them may be read off.
2. The weekly rate is a rate for a week, and the weekend rate is a rate for a day falling on a Saturday or
   a Sunday. The Premium Inclusive Rate publishes the highest figures on the card at 89.5 USD for a day and
   529 USD for a week; the Pay Now Saver Rate publishes the lowest at 38.5 USD and 229 USD.
3. The rate for a day kept beyond the booked return is a separate published figure from the daily rate, and
   on every class it stands above it.
4. The grace period is a number of minutes past the booked return time. The three grace periods on the card
   are 29 minutes, 59 minutes and 89 minutes, so no class carries a grace period of a full hour or more
   expressed in whole hours.
